notes.title: Kastle Krush - Launch Update
notes.notes:
Greetings dear players!

What a day! Today we announced and released Kastle Krush from Early Access. With huge new patch we are expanding the Kastle Krush universe in new ways, with all new mechanics, gameplay, and stories to tell.

CHANGELOG

General:

New playable race added
New map added
Achievement added (12 new and functional achievements to track your progress)
Unique weather effects implemented
More lovely decorations to fill maps with!
 

 
 Balance changes:

Upgrade cost to Sheepmen has been changed from 300 to 150 gold
Archer building cost has been changed from 700 to 450 gold
Upgrade cost to Crossbowman has been changed from 400 to 350 gold
Swordsman building cost has been changed from 900 to 300 gold
Horse building cost has been changed from 1000 to 500 gold
Upgrade cost to Knight has been changed from 1000 to 350 gold
Catapult building cost has been changed from 1200 to 1000 gold
Upgrade cost to Ballista has been changed from 1000 to 500 gold


Misc:

Menu Interface and system settings has been completely revamped
Game background has been reworked from scratch


 
 Fixes:

Resolution settings error fixed
Black textures appearance bug fixed
Building menu bug fixed
Sound settings save bug fixed
Registration of mouse clicks has been improved
